cards.name: Glimmerhold
cards.quote: Glimmerhold gleams like a hidden jewel in the stone, bright with the memory of deep craft.

cards.name: Aldenburg
cards.quote: The first riders of Mearhold raised Aldenburg before any other hall, and its gates still open eastward out of old habit.

cards.name: The Seeing Hill
cards.quote: The Seeing Hill crowns the river with a stern eye, as if watching for the same doom that once came south.

cards.name: The Hearing Hill
cards.quote: The Hearing Hill watches the vale with a stillness that can outlast kingdoms.

cards.name: Songhill
cards.quote: Songhill gleams with the old patience of a watchman who has seen the dusk before.

cards.name: Windtop
cards.quote: Weathertop remembers moonlight, blade, and the long ache of old days.

cards.name: Angarn
cards.quote: Angarn carries the iron memory of the mountains, where work and warning have always stood together.

cards.name: Karagmir
cards.quote: Karagmir is a dark hold of old metal and older grudges, and the stone remembers every strike.

cards.name: Aumeneth
cards.quote: The stones of Aumeneth wait in silence for the hand that shall wake them.

cards.name: Aralt
cards.quote: Aralt lies quiet beneath the hills, but the ground there still knows the tread of ancient feet.

cards.name: Ardhumir
cards.quote: The shipwrights of Ardhumir lay keels for the Corsairs and take their price in favours, not coin.

cards.name: Ashkirr
cards.quote: Ashkirr is ash-bright and watchful, as if the land had learned to glare back at the sun.

cards.name: Azanhold
cards.quote: At Azanhold, the walls are stern, and the silence is the silence of deep craft.

cards.name: Weftspire
cards.quote: Weftspire keeps a dark and sinking quiet, and few cross it without care.

cards.name: Nharoth
cards.quote: Barad-dûr broods over the ash like the final answer of a will that would not bend.

cards.name: Barrahn
cards.quote: Barrahn lifts a grim tower over the waste, and its shadow reaches farther than its walls.

cards.name: Wraithtower
cards.quote: Wraithtower stands like a dark sentinel over the waste, its shadow long with command.

cards.name: Barrakshor
cards.quote: Barrakshor keeps the grave look of the hills, as if it had been hewn to outlast grief.

cards.name: The Cairnfields
cards.quote: Lugrakh crouches over Nurhal like a black horn of the earth, and no light lingers long beside it.

cards.name: Bargost
cards.quote: The hard places of Bargost seem to answer only to patience and long memory.

cards.name: Bearhall
cards.quote: Bearhall stands as a stronghold of hearth and stern hospitality, where the bears’ memory is never far.

cards.name: Crossway
cards.quote: Crossway keeps faith with the road, though the years grow wary.

cards.name: Bramblemarch
cards.quote: At Bramblemarch the evening stillness is kept like a lamp in the window.

cards.name: Burwidd
cards.quote: Burwidd shelters its people beneath the wood, where the trees are old enough to judge strangers.

cards.name: Buthavais
cards.quote: Buthavais lies far from easy roads, where the silence of the land feels deliberate.

cards.name: Millpond
cards.quote: Millpond sits at the crossing of roads and the meeting of waters, and does not forget either.

cards.name: Foamisle
cards.quote: Foamisle holds the river like a spear-point, watching north and south with hard patience.

cards.name: Kaldhur
cards.quote: Half the cargo of Kaldhur is salt and fish; the ledgers do not say what the other half is.

cards.name: Kamreth
cards.quote: Kamreth rises over the fields like a warning that never forgot how to speak.

cards.name: The Iron Jaws
cards.quote: The Iron Jaws lies under a cruel name, and the stones there have not forgiven.

cards.name: Cruachan
cards.quote: At Cruachan, the walls are stern, and the silence is the silence of deep craft.
cards.actionEffect: The Cruel Mountain turns on those who trespass. Own mountain natives buffed. Own non-native mountain slowed. Enemy mountain emissaries gain Arcane Insight. Enemy mountain units 30-40% frozen; commanders halted.

cards.name: Amberhold
cards.quote: In Amberhold, the trees keep their own counsel, and none should presume to answer for them.

cards.name: Amarath
cards.quote: Amarath watches from the black wood as if the trees themselves had been set to guard a secret.

cards.name: Silverwatch
cards.quote: Beneath its boughs, Caras Celairnen keeps memory bright and still.

cards.name: Miralond
cards.quote: Miralond glows with a pale remnant of grandeur, though time has thinned its banners.

cards.name: Tolfaras
cards.quote: Tolfaras clings to the sea-wind with the stubborn grace of stone weathered but unbroken.

cards.name: Kern Duhl
cards.quote: Kern Duhl stands hard against the North, and even its ruin looks carved for endurance.

cards.name: Karvarad
cards.quote: Karvarad holds itself like a fortress of old resolve, half-buried in memory and rain.

cards.name: Cevrun
cards.quote: At Cevrun, the boughs bend low enough to listen, but not to forgive.

cards.name: Silverbourne
cards.quote: At Silverbourne, the boughs bend low enough to listen, but not to forgive.

cards.name: Silverfast
cards.quote: Silverfast stands where the veins run thin but the will of its makers runs deep.

cards.name: The Golden Mound
cards.quote: The Golden Mound lifts a green and golden hush above LÃ³rien, where even sorrow seems to keep its distance.

cards.name: The Weft Stair
cards.quote: The Weft Stair is a soft place, and its softness is the first of its deceits.

cards.name: Crook Hollow
cards.quote: Crook Hollow lies quiet under hedge and hill, a hidden door for those who must travel unseen.

cards.name: Dalemoot
cards.quote: Dalemoot keeps the memory of the Long Lake and the mountain road, bright with trade and hard with loss.

cards.name: The Drowned Fen
cards.quote: The reeds about The Drowned Fen whisper like witnesses who would rather not be named.

cards.name: The Dern Ring
cards.quote: The Dern Ring shelters the ancient wood with a silence that feels almost vowed.

cards.name: Dol Vorrath
cards.quote: Dol Vorrath festers under the trees, and the wood around it seems to draw a darker breath.

cards.name: Swanhold
cards.quote: Swanhold shines like a white helm set upon the sea, bright against the long road of dusk.

cards.name: Drusan Forest
cards.quote: The hush of Drusan Forest is deep as root and as old as the first road through the dark.

cards.name: Dunbarrow
cards.quote: Dunbarrow lies in the mountains like a grave that has chosen to stand upright.

cards.name: Durthrang
cards.quote: Durthrang clings to the Emyn Muil with a grim old patience, and its black height still dares the sky.

cards.name: The Skyrie
cards.quote: High on the eyrie the Eagles keep a lonely watch.

cards.name: Easterfold
cards.quote: Easterfold lies open to wind and horse-track, and its fields remember riders before plowmen.

cards.name: Aelhaven
cards.quote: The broken haven still hears the sea in its sleep.

cards.name: Mearsted
cards.quote: Mearsted keeps its golden roofs against the sky, and the wind there still remembers riders.

cards.name: Elgarr
cards.quote: Elgarr is ringed with a quiet that makes every hoofbeat sound like trespass.

cards.name: Vaelstir
cards.quote: Vaelstir keeps its gaze westward, as if memory itself were a star.

cards.name: Ennodir
cards.quote: Ennodir holds the road with the stubborn silence of a place that has buried too many names.

cards.name: Erenkarr (Lost)
cards.quote: Erenkarr (Lost) keeps its noble outline even in ruin, like a crown left in ash.

cards.name: The Oathstone
cards.quote: The Oathstone remembers the oath-stones, and even the wind there speaks with old restraint.

cards.name: Blackwold
cards.quote: Blackwold keeps the old forestÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã¢â€žÂ¢s memory under its boughs, green and unbowed in the dusk.

cards.name: Merehaven
cards.quote: Merehaven gleams on the water's edge, bright enough to tempt memory and fire alike.

cards.name: Wealdwatch Camp
cards.quote: Wealdwatch Camp sits at the edge of the Weald like a hesitant footstep beside an ancient mind.

cards.name: Whitestrand
cards.quote: The bells of Whitestrand ring for the tide as faithfully as for the King.

cards.name: Fenngate
cards.quote: At Fenngate, the water is still enough to hide danger and patient enough to keep it.

cards.name: Northhaven
cards.quote: Northhaven faces the western sea with the old patience of the Eldar, and its shore is never idle.

cards.name: Kingsfast
cards.quote: Fornost lies like a fallen crown upon the North.

cards.name: Rimewatch
cards.quote: Under the hard sky of Rimewatch, even silence has a stern voice.

cards.name: Frennsburg
cards.quote: Frennsburg keeps a stern watch over the river-country, as if Fram’s old strength had never loosened its grip.

cards.name: Frewold
cards.quote: Frewold clings to the high shoulders of the mountains, and its herdsmen count old grudges as carefully as their goats.
cards.actionEffect: The Cruel Mountain turns on those who trespass. Own mountain natives buffed. Own non-native mountain slowed. Enemy mountain emissaries gain Arcane Insight. Enemy mountain units 30-40% frozen; commanders halted.

cards.name: Galbrand
cards.quote: Galbrand stands where the forest climbs the mountain, and its sentries walk on branch and battlement alike.

cards.name: The Irisfields
cards.quote: The Gladden Fields lie hushed, where water and reed keep old secrets.

cards.name: The Under Gate
cards.quote: The Under Gate gnaws at the pass like a broken fang, and the dark beyond it is never still.

cards.name: Maglon Keep
cards.quote: Maglon Keep opens beneath the sky, and there is little there to soften the eye of war.

cards.name: Gunnabar
cards.quote: Gunnabar bears the deep memory of the North, grim as a mountain scar that never closed.

cards.name: Southhaven
cards.quote: Southhaven stands by tide or river as if waiting for something that has not yet named itself.

cards.name: The Corsarn Havens
cards.quote: The The Corsarn Havens smile to the sea like a bright knife hidden in silk.

cards.name: The Deepgard
cards.quote: The Deepgard bears the mark of war, yet its walls still answer with iron courage.

cards.name: The Sunset Window
cards.quote: The Sunset Window hides the stream in shadow, as though the land itself guarded the hidden door.

cards.name: Hollyburrow
cards.quote: The green of Hollyburrow seems soft, yet it has a watchful heart.

cards.name: Ilannin
cards.quote: Ilannin is quiet under the east wind, and its stillness feels like a warning held back.

cards.name: Imdorath
cards.quote: Imdorath feels like a hall built for men who kept faith when the world forgot them.

cards.name: Imravel
cards.quote: In Imravel grief is borne as song, and not as burden.

cards.name: Isighir
cards.quote: Isighir feels like a gate forgotten by empire and remembered by none but crows.

cards.name: Jurajesh
cards.quote: Jurajesh guards its own heat and dust, a place where the desert has learned to keep secrets.

cards.name: Kal Narghil
cards.quote: Kal Narghil grips the hills in black silence, where no bird lingers long.

cards.name: Kashadoul
cards.quote: Kashadoul stands under a heat-hazed sky, and its walls seem to hoard the dayÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã¢â€žÂ¢s last breath.

cards.name: Kashafra
cards.quote: Kashafra clings to the edge of the southern heat, where even shadow seems worn thin.

cards.name: Khardamu
cards.quote: Khardamu drinks the sun and gives back only heat, dust, and hard intent.

cards.name: Durndelve
cards.quote: Durndelve endures in buried majesty, and the dark below it still rings with memory.

cards.name: Khelnala
cards.quote: At Khelnala, the water runs clear and the ore runs true, and both are hoarded with equal care.

cards.name: Lagleth
cards.quote: The watch-orcs of Lagleth squint across the ash of TheEmberpit, counting every spark the Mountain throws.

cards.name: Kraghold
cards.quote: The snows above Kraghold are trampled black, for its garrison never sleeps and never leaves.

cards.name: Lagorath
cards.quote: Lagorath sits under a low sky, and the wind there sounds almost like counsel.

cards.name: Skarra Camp
cards.quote: Skarra Camp lies under a restless sky, and the stillness there feels earned by threat.

cards.name: Vraskar
cards.quote: Vraskar watches from a barren reach, half-fortress and half-buried warning.

cards.name: Laorkhi
cards.quote: Laorkhi keeps its own counsel, where the earth is old and the paths are few.

cards.name: Larach Dunn
cards.quote: From Larach Dunn the war-bands of Wyldmoor gather, and the smoke of their forges drifts down the dale.

cards.name: Larhuzz
cards.quote: Larhuzz endures like an old work of Dwarven hands, sure, severe, and unbending.

cards.name: Linhar
cards.quote: Linhar keeps its harbor face to the tides, with Ardanth’s old courage under the salt air.

cards.name: Greymouth Haven
cards.quote: Lond Daer still leans upon the river, as though the age of ships were not yet done.

cards.name: Lugarr
cards.quote: Lugarr crouches beneath the old shadow, waiting with the patience of iron.

cards.name: Lugrakh
cards.quote: Lugrakh crouches beneath the old shadow, waiting with the patience of iron.

cards.name: Methelburg
cards.quote: Methelburg holds its river crossing like a clasp of iron, small but unwilling to break.

cards.name: Marlbourne High
cards.quote: Men of the North Downs say Marlbourne High was built to watch one star, and fell when that star was no longer watched.

cards.name: Methira
cards.quote: Methira keeps the old road under a guarded sky, and every stone there seems to have a watcher.

cards.name: Great Delving
cards.quote: Great Delving stands small to the eye, yet stout in the keeping of the Thornhollow.

cards.name: Durlith Spire
cards.quote: Durlith Spire watches from a black spur of the Mountains of Ash, and nothing crosses the grey slopes beneath it unmarked.

cards.name: The Pale City
cards.quote: The Pale City burns with a pale malice, and the road to it seems to remember fear.

cards.name: Sunspire
cards.quote: Sunspire rises white against the long shadow of the East, steadfast as a horn-call at dawn.

cards.name: Mornspire
cards.quote: Mornspire stands in stern splendor, and its towers hold the wind like a vow.

cards.name: Mistrande
cards.quote: The riders of Mistrande break their horses on the open steppe, and their bargains wherever it profits them.

cards.name: The Ironmaw
cards.quote: The Ironmaw stands unyielding, a gate that has learned to answer only to ruin.

cards.name: Blackroot Post
cards.quote: Blackroot Post stands as if carved from the will of the men who would not yield the river-road.

cards.name: The Emberwound
cards.quote: The Emberwound broods in fire and ash, as though the mountain itself had grown a bitter heart.

cards.name: Mount Grunn
cards.quote: Mount Grunn stands with a dwarf-fast stubbornness, as though the hill itself had taken a vow.

cards.name: Nandruin
cards.quote: From the flets of Nandruin the wardens mark every shadow that creeps out of the mountains toward the Golden Wood.

cards.name: Neburkha
cards.quote: Neburkha shelters a stillness that feels earned, as though hardship had taken root and stayed.

cards.name: The Swanfens
cards.quote: The reeds of The Swanfens hide fires that cannot be found twice by the same path.
cards.actionEffect: The Cruel Mountain turns on those who trespass. Own mountain natives buffed. Own non-native mountain slowed. Enemy mountain emissaries gain Arcane Insight. Enemy mountain units 30-40% frozen; commanders halted.

cards.name: Norgrad
cards.quote: Norgrad rings with the memory of smiths, and its broken halls still listen for the hammer.

cards.name: Norrhold
cards.quote: In the northern dark, the old delvings still yield to those who speak the true names of stone.

cards.name: Nurmurl
cards.quote: Nurmurl stands in a country that has taught itself to endure by never sleeping.

cards.name: Olbamar
cards.quote: Olbamar keeps its old hush by the water, and the reeds there seem to remember names.

cards.name: The Elderwood
cards.quote: The The Elderwood is older than the road, and not all old things are kindly.

cards.name: Onghazar
cards.quote: Onghazar is a thorn of a place, sharp enough to turn away easy hope.

cards.name: Ordugavais
cards.quote: Ordugavais feels like a watch-post left standing after the rest of a kingdom was taken away.

cards.name: Thornspire
cards.quote: Thornspire stands black and precise, as if stone itself had been taught arrogance.

cards.name: Starholt
cards.quote: Starholt bears its wounds openly, yet the river still remembers the city that once was.

cards.name: Ostvaelin
cards.quote: Bandits out of Wyldmoor now camp in the courts of Ostvaelin, warming their hands in the ruin of the old forge-courts.

cards.name: Ostgurth
cards.quote: Ostgurth keeps its secrets in the stone, where even echoes seem cautious.

cards.name: Ovathrak
cards.quote: Ovathrak keeps the feel of a place where power once walked and still leaves its footprints.

cards.name: The Dead Roads
cards.quote: The The Dead Roads still feel the chill of unbreathed oaths, and no cheer lingers there.

cards.name: Kingsquay
cards.quote: Kingsquay wears the scars of trade and war alike, yet the tide still brings and carries its memory.

cards.name: Pellandur
cards.quote: Pellandur stands between sea and memory, a place where old trade routes left more than footprints.

cards.name: Reaver Hold
cards.quote: At Reaver Hold, the water carries old news, and none can tell which tidings are friendly.

cards.name: Rendhal
cards.quote: Rendhal's shepherds watch the long grass-hills of Longstrand, where news of the wide world arrives a season late.

cards.name: Mossgable
cards.quote: In Mossgable, the trees keep their own counsel, and none should presume to answer for them.

cards.name: Rhubarr
cards.quote: Rhubarr lies beneath the weight of old kings, and the stones still know their names.

cards.name: Rivadd
cards.quote: Rivadd is crossed by old rumors and older streams, and neither has lost its way.

cards.name: Rulth
cards.quote: Rulth sits like a watchfire long gone cold, but the ground around it still knows watchfulness.

cards.name: Stoneford
cards.quote: At Stoneford the river keeps the western gate.

cards.name: Blossomford
cards.quote: Blossomford lies by the water like a watching stone, patient and unadorned.

cards.name: Gorwing Stair
cards.quote: Gorwing Stair crouches beneath the forest edge, where tree-shadow and river-mist meet in secrecy.

cards.name: Sarragost
cards.quote: Snow lies deep on the walls of Sarragost, and at sundown the garrison reads red omens in it.

cards.name: The Weaver's Lair
cards.quote: The Weaver's Lair breathes with old malice, and even the stone seems to shy from the dark within it.

cards.name: Skarrenkain
cards.quote: Skarrenkain broods in silence, as if the dark there had learned to wait.

cards.name: Stockleigh
cards.quote: Stockleigh keeps watch upon the Bramblemarch road, where a lamp in the window still means comfort against the dark.

cards.name: Stowbury
cards.quote: In Stowbury the horses are stabled nearer the hearth than the men, and no one thinks it strange.

cards.name: Sturlurtsa Kharda
cards.quote: Sturlurtsa Kharda keeps the hard memory of a road where riders once vanished into dust.

cards.name: Tarnbar
cards.quote: The Rangers of Tarnbar mend their grey cloaks by fires that cast no light beyond the palisade.

cards.name: Tallenvar
cards.quote: Tallenvar watches the western road, and its lanterns have guided many a kinsman home.

cards.name: Tharrow
cards.quote: Great piers of stone still stride across the Greyflood at Tharrow, carrying a bridge that ends in air.

cards.name: The Wedge
cards.quote: Between Hoarwell and Loudwater the Firstbloods of the Angle keep their hidden watch, remembered by few and forgetting nothing.

cards.name: The Crag
cards.quote: The Crag rises from the river like a held breath, old as the ford beneath it.

cards.name: The Giantmoors
cards.quote: The fogs of the Ettenmoors roll downhill like a tide, and what walks within them is best left unnamed.

cards.name: The Last Quays
cards.quote: The Last Quays look west with a sorrow that has long since learned grace.

cards.name: The Deepholes
cards.quote: The Deepholes keep what the Chief does not wish spoken of â€” and those who spoke too freely.

cards.name: The Troll Thickets
cards.quote: Three shapes of weathered stone stand in the Trollshaws yet, quarrelling forever over how to cook their supper.

cards.name: Durnhall
cards.quote: Durnhall holds the hush of a dwarf-kingÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã¢â€žÂ¢s hall, where even fire seems to speak in runes.

cards.name: The Woodking's Halls
cards.quote: The hush of The Woodking's Halls is deep as root and as old as the first road through the dark.

cards.name: Thurangost
cards.quote: Thurangost bears the mark of old terror, and the land around it has not forgotten the touch.

cards.name: Isle of Burath
cards.quote: Isle of Burath drifts on the Sea of RhÃƒÂ»n like a rumor that has learned to sail.

cards.name: Trefarn
cards.quote: Trefarn holds to the land with a farmerÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã¢â€žÂ¢s patience and a watchmanÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã¢â€žÂ¢s eye.

cards.name: Urlutsun
cards.quote: Urlutsun endures in the heat with a rough and stubborn silence, like a camp that refused to die.

cards.name: Urshanna
cards.quote: Urshanna squats upon the battle-plain like a camp that forgot to move on, its wells dug between old spears.

cards.name: Vamagh
cards.quote: The trees of Vamagh grow down to the tide line, and what is unloaded beneath them is never spoken of in the ports of the north.

cards.name: Wathdun
cards.quote: Wathdun leans into the wind with a grim pride that refuses to be bent.

cards.name: Westerfold
cards.quote: Westerfold opens to the plains with a stubborn calm that no storm has taught to bow.

cards.name: Woodfolk Steading
cards.quote: Woodfolk Steading keeps a plain folk-stead’s courage, with smoke, timber, and the watch of the woods about it.

cards.name: Zarrakh
cards.quote: The western halls remember the hammer, though few now walk their deep ways.
